In Rails, `create_table ..., force: true` will drop an existing table before creating it, which can cause silent data loss if the migration is re-run or if the table already exists (e.g., partial/failed setup). Modifying an already-versioned migration also adds avoidable churn that complicates auditing. This is a real, diff-grounded concern, though it typically won’t affect normal one-time migration runs.
